orientations.intent: Determine whether a remote workforce calendar can be queried through the available tools.

final_message:
Based on the tools available to me (a code repository handle, a tests handle, a git handle, and an episodes handle), there is no tool or capability for querying a remote workforce calendar. These handles only expose repository/code-related operations (status, orient, etc.) and episode data — nothing related to calendar, scheduling, or workforce-management systems.

**No — a remote workforce calendar cannot be queried through the tools currently available to me.**

files.content: Roster windows are repository-local and do not contact a calendar service.
